rounds.question: Sandbox tracker: net job approval (percent approve minus percent disapprove) among US registered voters, as the dashboard shows it on Friday 2028-01-07. This round is a rehearsal and is never placed in the season.
rounds.resolve: the scalar value in the committed sandbox source artifact

rounds.question: Sandbox tracker: net job approval in each of four party groups on 2028-01-07, as one joint profile. Every cell is required -- the energy score is a norm over the whole vector, so a profile with a hole has no score. This round is a rehearsal and is never placed in the season.
rounds.resolve: the four-cell vector in the committed sandbox source artifact
rounds.unit: net points (approve minus disapprove), per cell

rounds.question: Sandbox tracker: the five sandbox topics in order of the attention they take in the week Sun Jan 9 - Sat Jan 15, 2028, rank 1 first. The basket is fixed, so the answer is a permutation of exactly these five. This round is a rehearsal and is never placed in the season.
rounds.resolve: the ordered list in the committed sandbox source artifact
rounds.unit: ordered list of 5 sandbox topics, rank 1 first
